palettes.$comment: Visual group colour file (R11). Roles: one accent (the page's only saturated colour), base (an unselected mark), nodata (no row or a null value; never step 0), ink and white (text inside a painted mark: the core picks the one with the higher WCAG contrast), edge (outline of a painted mark whose step is under 3:1 on a page ground). grounds: the page backgrounds. sequential: per palette id, one explicit table per number of classes k = 3..9, light to dark, as ColorBrewer ships them. Colours are '#' and six lowercase hex digits, nothing else. Checked at load by palette_ok; made by works/r11-color-scale/gen_palette.py.
